_meta.purpose: 2026 rookie class upside board. Rookies have NO NFL stats, so this is built from draft capital, landing spot, projected role, and preseason news — not from player_stats.json. Treat as ceiling bets: first-year value is lowest, so mid/late picks on high-ceiling rookies are where leagues get won.
_meta.as_of: late Aug / early Sep 2026 — VERIFY with live news on draft day (roles and injuries move fast)
_meta.sources: consensus of PFN, Yahoo/Sporting News, ESPN (Clay), SI, RotoBaller, DraftSharks
_meta.avoid_flag: players carrying an 'avoid' field are on a do-not-draft/bust list (see espn_avoid_2026.json)

rookies.name: Jeremiyah Love
rookies.draft_capital: 1st round, 3rd overall (first RB top-5 since Barkley 2018)
rookies.role: Do-it-all three-down back; Doak Walker winner. BUT LaFleur easing him in — sharing 1st-team reps with Tyler Allgeier, James Conner returning as RB3.
rookies.upside: RB1 ceiling on draft-capital alone; the 9 most recent top-12 RBs all finished top-12 as rookies.
rookies.risk: Crowded backfield early; Cardinals offense modest with Jacoby Brissett at QB.
rookies.adp_note: Highest rookie ADP — not a discount. Priced as a real pick.

avoid.reason: Rookie hype outrunning reality: preseason high-ankle sprain, Allgeier starting Week 1, backfield crowded with Conner/Benson.

rookies.name: Jadarian Price
rookies.draft_capital: Notre Dame (behind Love in college); mid-round NFL pick
rookies.role: Path to 15-20 touches Week 1 if Zach Charbonnet (ACL) isn't back; Seattle led NFL in RB carries inside the 20.
rookies.upside: Some analysts flip him ABOVE Love for pure upside — best offensive environment of the rookie RBs.
rookies.risk: Charbonnet return date, possible Super Bowl hangover, new OC, Aug lower-body soreness (George Holani took 1st-team reps).
rookies.adp_note: ~RB41 on Sleeper — big discount for the ceiling. Prime value target.

rookies.name: Jordyn Tyson
rookies.role: Pairs with Chris Olave under Kellen Moore's pass-friendly offense.
rookies.upside: Viewed by several as the best pure WR talent in the class — can surpass Tate as rookie WR1.
rookies.risk: Likely the WR2 on his own team; hamstring/ankle question.

rookies.name: Carnell Tate
rookies.role: Good chance to lead Titans in WR volume; grows with Cam Ward in year 2.
rookies.upside: Team WR1 target share as a rookie; projected ~PPR WR39.
rookies.risk: Daboll's TEN offense may lag; QB still developing.

rookies.name: KC Concepcion
rookies.role: Browns manufacturing touches — sweeps, screens, slot volume. High PPR floor.
rookies.upside: PPR-friendly engineered usage with room for explosive games; some now have him top-5 rookie.
rookies.risk: Shaky Cleveland QB situation caps the ceiling; Jeudy + Boston compete for targets.

rookies.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
rookies.role: Flashing in camp with Deebo (30, injury-prone) and Pearsall banged up; 49ers pass offense elite (top-8 YPA, top-5 pass yards 3 straight years).
rookies.upside: One injury ahead of him unlocks real volume in a great offense — classic league-winner profile.
rookies.risk: Needs an injury/opportunity to matter; buried if everyone's healthy.

rookies.name: Makai Lemon
rookies.role: Lands in Philadelphia's offense; rookie WR depth behind established options.
rookies.upside: Top-tier rookie talent; ceiling tied to carving a role.
rookies.risk: Target competition in an established offense.

rookies.name: Kenyon Sadiq
rookies.role: Elite athletic profile (4.39 forty, 43.5" vertical); first rookie TE off the board.
rookies.upside: TE is thin — an athletic move TE who hits is a positional edge.
rookies.risk: Rookie TEs historically take a year+ to produce.

rookies.name: Fernando Mendoza
rookies.draft_capital: No. 1 overall pick (Heisman, national title at Indiana)
rookies.role: Rookie QB1 of the class; steps into the Raiders' offense.
rookies.upside: Top pedigree; QB1 rookie with rushing/passing tools.
rookies.risk: Rookie QBs are volatile; supporting cast questions.

rookies.name: Nicholas Singleton
rookies.role: Penn State product; overlooked backfield asset.
rookies.upside: Deep sleeper whose talent outruns his draft slot if given a role.
rookies.risk: Buried on depth chart; needs opportunity.
